Implemented resumable imports using a snapshot pinned on the job’s first run, a stable keyset cursor that includes ingest sequence to break ordering ties, and job-scoped locking to serialize concurrent resumes. Upserts now use a stable per-job, per-row idempotency key, so retries converge if a failure occurs after an upsert.
